data_description.enabled_data: Choose only the data you need. Existing hubs retain their previous selection. Warning: an empty selection creates no school-data sensors. Dashboards and blueprints require their corresponding categories to be selected.
data_description.mailbox_full_content: Full message content is off by default. When on, bodies and attachments are fetched only for conversations you have already read in Mashov, so unread conversations stay unread until you open them in Mashov.
data_description.mailbox_limit: Up to 50 recent inbox conversations. Older conversations are not fetched.
data_description.mailbox_attachments: Off by default. Needs Mailbox and full message content. Saves attachments of already-read conversations in the Home Assistant config folder (mashov_files), where they are included in backups. Only signed-in Home Assistant users can download them.
data_description.mailbox_attachment_max_mb: Larger attachments are skipped and marked too_large (1–100 MB, default 25).

options.title: Refresh schedules
options.help: Select General to edit the default. Choose a data type to set its own schedule, or keep Use General checked. Switch between types freely; Submit saves all changes together.

options.student_help: These schedules apply only to the selected student. General sets this student’s default; each data type can use its own schedule.
options.account_help: Holidays belong to the school and Mailbox to the account. Other schedules here are inherited defaults for students without overrides.

closed_feature.title: Mashov data type turned off
closed_feature.description:
{hub}: the school portal returned HTTP 5xx errors for **{feature}** on several separate refreshes, so the integration stopped fetching it. This usually means the school has closed this feature.

To fetch it again when the school reopens it, select **{feature}** under the hub's Configure → Data to fetch.
